content: The AHA 2009 schedule outlines the coordination of interviews during the event. Filming will take place at the Hilton Orlando, located at 6001 Destination Parkway, Orlando, FL 32819, from Saturday, November 14, to Tuesday, November 17, 2009. Dr. Gibson is available for interviews during all times marked in black. However, during times marked in green, Dr. Gibson will not be available to conduct interviews. During these times, you may proceed with discussing your topic or presenting your slides. On Saturday, November 14, 2009: At 9:00 AM, the interviewee is Gennaro Sardella. The trial being discussed is the Impact of Thrombectomy with EXPORT Catheter in Infarct-Related Artery during Primary PCI on Procedural Outcome in Patients with AMI (EXPIRA Trial). The focus will be on the 24-month clinical outcomes. At 10:00 AM, the interviewee is Philippe Gabriel Steg. The trial being discussed is the PLATO Trial. At 10:30 AM, the interviewee is Jeanne E.
